stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They only see the bill later.”?
options: Information can change behavior when it is clear, personal, and connected to choices people can actually make.
But it became popular because people learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression.
Restoring a name does not change the river's water, but it changes how people listen to it.
But it showed that change becomes easier when people can see it, count it, and do it together.
